acceptanceCriteria: focused-docs and full-gate gate results retain bounded output evidence (at least the failing make target and its last lines) through a policy update (version+1) carried to main.
A failing focused-docs gate in a fixture or live attempt shows the failing check in ticket show / gate result without rerunning.
Evidence stays bounded and secret-screened per existing gate-evidence rules; receipt audit passes.
body: Observed 2026-10-21 during the 109-ticket delivered-closeout run (corvint-tasks local build 402+, policyVersion 13): V1-1878 and V1-0553 completes were REFUSED GATE_FAILED for focused-docs, and the gate result carried no stdout/stderr because .taskman/policy.json declares evidence [] for focused-docs and full-gate (other COMMAND gates declare ["output"]). Diagnosing required re-creating a worktree at the seal and rerunning make; the cause was 2 stale line citations (docs/specs/core-compatibility-freeze-v1.md:228-229, cmd/corvint/affected.go anchors) present at the seal tree and repinned later on main. Expected: a failed gate retains a bounded, secret-screened output tail naming the failing target. Actual: outcome FAILED with no reason.

title: Tasks policy gates focused-docs and full-gate retain no output evidence, so GATE_FAILED cannot be diagnosed without rerunning the gate
